{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "HazardConsequence",
      "name": "Toxicity dispersion",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "The incident involved the inadvertent mixing of sulfuric acid and sodium hypochlorite, which \"produced a cloud containing chlorine and other compounds.\" In the incident description, \"a greenish-yellow gas began emitting from the sodium hypochlorite bulk tank, forming a cloud. The cloud grew, covering the Harcros truck and the Mod B building, and then migrated offsite in a northeast direction.\" The report states that \"over 140 individuals, including members of the public, MGPI employees, and a Harcros employee, sought medical attention\" and that community shelter-in-place and evacuation orders were issued.",
      "explanation": "The primary hazard consequence is the offsite and onsite dispersion of a toxic chlorine-containing gas cloud generated by incompatible chemical mixing. The report's central analysis focuses on toxic plume formation, migration, public protective actions, and exposure impacts rather than combustion or explosion phenomena.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "sulfuric acid",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "scheduled delivery of 30% sulfuric acid",
      "explanation": "Sulfuric acid was the delivered chemical that was misrouted into the wrong tank and initiated the incompatible reaction.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "sodium hypochlorite",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "the inadvertent mixing of approximately 4,000 gallons of sulfuric acid and 5,850 gallons of sodium hypochlorite",
      "explanation": "Sodium hypochlorite in the bulk tank reacted with sulfuric acid to generate the toxic gas cloud.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "chlorine gas",
      "node_id": "En3",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "the primary toxic reaction products were likely chlorine and other chlorine-containing compounds",
      "explanation": "Chlorine was the principal toxic material driving the harmful onsite and offsite dispersion consequence.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "chemical unloading area",
      "node_id": "En4",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "At 7:44 AM, the operator escorted the driver from the Mod B building to the chemical unloading area.",
      "explanation": "The unloading area was where the transfer connection was made and the misconnection occurred.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "sodium hypochlorite bulk tank",
      "node_id": "En5",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "a greenish-yellow gas began emitting from the sodium hypochlorite bulk tank",
      "explanation": "The incompatible materials mixed in this tank, and the toxic gas cloud was released from it.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "Vapor",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "a greenish-yellow gas began emitting from the sodium hypochlorite bulk tank",
      "explanation": "The harmful released material was present as a toxic gas cloud.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Pressure",
      "name": "Low pressure",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "The liquid that was added to the tank and the gases that evolved from the reaction were released through a 3-inch diameter atmospheric vent and an 18-inch lid on the roof of the bulk tank.",
      "explanation": "The toxic gases vented to the atmosphere from the tank rather than from a high-pressure rupture.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "High temperature",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "Upon mixing, the sodium hypochlorite and sulfuric acid immediately initiated a highly exothermic, or heat-producing, reaction.",
      "explanation": "The reaction generated heat, contributing to hot gas formation and plume behavior.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Volatility",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report describes gas generation and cloud formation but does not explicitly classify volatility.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident report focuses on toxic reaction products and does not explicitly state a combustibility classification for the hazardous material in this scenario.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "ToxicSubstance",
      "name": "Toxic",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "the primary toxic reaction products were likely chlorine and other chlorine-containing compounds",
      "explanation": "The released cloud contained toxic chlorine-containing compounds that caused widespread exposure and medical treatment.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Asphyxiant",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report attributes harm to toxic inhalation effects and does not classify the released material as an asphyxiant.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Conductivity",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C8",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident description does not discuss electrical conductivity.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Continuous release",
      "node_id": "C9",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "a greenish-yellow gas began emitting from the sodium hypochlorite bulk tank, forming a cloud. The cloud grew",
      "explanation": "The toxic gas was generated and released over time as sulfuric acid continued entering the wrong tank until responders stopped the truck discharge.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "Low confinement",
      "node_id": "C10",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "forming a cloud. The cloud grew, covering the Harcros truck and the Mod B building, and then migrated offsite in a northeast direction.",
      "explanation": "The release occurred outdoors and dispersed broadly rather than accumulating within a confined enclosure.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Dispersed",
      "node_id": "C11",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "The cloud grew, covering the Harcros truck and the Mod B building, and then migrated offsite in a northeast direction.",
      "explanation": "The released toxic gas formed a plume that spread onsite and offsite.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Sulfuric acid discharge hose connected to sodium hypochlorite fill line",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "The driver connected the sulfuric acid discharge hose to the unsecured fill line for the sodium hypochlorite bulk tank",
      "explanation": "This misconnection was the first abnormal event that directly initiated the incompatible mixing and subsequent toxic gas release.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
